heading: What we collect
body: SixUp has no account system, no advertising, no analytics and no tracking. The only data that leaves your device is purchase information for SixUp Pro, described below.

heading: Purchases
body: SixUp Pro is a one-time in-app purchase processed by Apple. To confirm and restore it, the app uses RevenueCat, which receives a random anonymous ID created by the app and your App Store purchase record (product, price and date). It is used only to unlock SixUp Pro on your devices, is not linked to your name or email, and is never used for tracking or advertising. RevenueCat's privacy policy: https://www.revenuecat.com/privacy.

heading: Study data stays on your device
body: Your plan, check-ins, answers, scores, word reviews and saved words are stored on your device.

heading: Recordings and writing
body: Recordings made for speaking practice are transcribed and scored on your device and are never uploaded. Essays and answers are scored on your device, including by Apple's on-device model on supported devices.

heading: iCloud sync
body: If you are signed in to iCloud, your study progress syncs between your own devices through Apple's iCloud key-value storage under Apple's privacy policy. The developer cannot access it. Recordings are not synced.

heading: Permissions
list: Microphone: records your spoken answers for speaking practice.
Speech recognition: transcribes those recordings on your device.
Notifications: the daily study reminder you choose.
